Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Medical College & Hospital Faridabad Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Faridabad?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview and document verification for the Senior Resident posts at ESIC Medical College & Hospital Faridabad is scheduled for 24th September 2026. Candidates are advised to report within the specified time frame.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: For the Senior Resident post, candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree. For the Non-PG Resident post, an MBBS degree with 2 years of relevant experience is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 45 years. Specific age relaxations for reserved categories are not detailed in the provided information and should be checked in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 49 vacancies announced for the Senior Resident and Non-PG Resident positions at ESIC Medical College & Hospital Faridabad.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident and Non-PG Resident posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay for Senior Residents is Rs. 1,50,294/-, and for Non-PG Residents, it is Rs. 1,23,196/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ESIC Faridabad recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for General and Other categories. SC/ST/ESIC (Regular Employee)/Female Candidate, and PH candidates are exempted from the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these contractual positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Document Verification followed by an Interview. Candidates must ensure all their documents are in order for the verification stage.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Employees State Insurance Corporation Medical College & Hospital, Faridabad, Haryana, 121001.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their completed application form, original documents, and self-attested copies of all relevant certificates, including educational qualifications, experience, and category proof (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is contractual, as indicated in the recruitment notification for ESIC Medical College & Hospital Faridabad.
